usage: NASA imagery used as texture maps in an illustrative community space; not real-time Earth data. No endorsement is implied.

sources.name: earth-day
sources.credit: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Image by Reto Stöckli (land surface, shallow water, clouds); enhancements by Robert Simmon (ocean color and compositing).
sources.adaptation: Resized to 2048×1024 when needed; encoded as WebP. Globe lighting and atmosphere are rendered in Three.js.

sources.name: earth-night
sources.credit: NASA Earth Observatory image by Robert Simmon, using Suomi NPP VIIRS data provided courtesy of Chris Elvidge (NOAA National Geophysical Data Center).
sources.adaptation: Resized to 2048×1024 when needed; encoded as WebP. Globe lighting and atmosphere are rendered in Three.js.

home_plates.notes: Authored camera, sun direction and atmosphere. Static raster plates have scroll-driven camera motion in CSS; the home page does not run a WebGL Earth.
